OnboardingWelcomeTitle: Welcome to a lighter API workspace
OnboardingWelcomeBody: ReqMint keeps everyday request building fast and focused. No account is required, and you decide when Git or exports leave the app.
OnboardingWelcomeNote: This short introduction explains ReqMint's local-first privacy boundary before you open your first workspace.
OnboardingPrivacyBody: Workspaces are readable files you control. Sensitive values use the operating-system vault, while response previews and history stay bounded on this device.
OnboardingPrivacyLocalBody: Requests work without a ReqMint account or cloud workspace.
OnboardingPrivacyGitBody: Commits, pulls, and pushes always require your explicit action.
OnboardingReadyBody: Create a local workspace or open an existing one when you are ready. ReqMint keeps advanced Git, Runner, and secret-vault tools out of the way until you need them.
OnboardingReadyNote: You can restart this introduction at any time from Settings. Skipping never disables product features.
TutorialSendInstruction: Step 1 of 2 · The URL uses the Tutorial environment. Select Send to call the loopback API on this device.
TutorialSaveInstruction: Step 2 of 2 · Review the 200 response and JSON body, then select Save to add this request to Getting Started.
TutorialCompleteInstruction: Complete · Your first local request is saved. This temporary workspace and its loopback API are removed when ReqMint exits.
TutorialUnsavedWorkspaceChanges: Save or discard workspace edits before opening the tutorial
TutorialFailedStatus: The local tutorial could not be prepared
TextGitReadOnly: ReqMint never pulls or pushes automatically. Staging and commits require a scoped review and explicit confirmation.
GitNotRepository: Workspace is not inside a Git repository
GitNoWorkspace: Open a workspace to inspect Git status
GitNotInstalled: Git is not installed or available
GitStatusFailed: Git status could not be loaded
GitSecretWarnings: Security check found {0} possible secret findings across {1} files
GitDiffBlockedBySecrets: Preview blocked because this version may contain a secret.
GitDiffBlockedByScan: Preview blocked because this version could not be inspected safely.
GitDiffUnavailable: Diff preview is unavailable for this file.
GitConflictIntroduction: ReqMint will not modify this conflicted file automatically. Resolve it explicitly, then refresh Git status.
GitConflictStep1: 1. Open the file in your Git editor and review both versions.
GitConflictStep2: 2. Keep the correct JSON blocks and remove all conflict markers: <<<<<<<, ======= and >>>>>>>.
GitConflictStep3: 3. Validate the resulting JSON and ensure secret values were not pasted into the workspace file.
GitConflictStep4: 4. Save the file, refresh Git status in ReqMint, then review the clean diff before staging externally.
GitConflictSafetyNote: ReqMint does not auto-resolve, stage or commit conflicts. Secret values must remain in the operating-system vault.
GitStageReviewMessage: Only the file shown above will be added to the Git index. Review its working-tree diff before continuing.
GitStageSafetyNote: ReqMint runs the secret check again immediately before and after staging. This action does not commit, pull, push, or include other repository files.
GitStageBlockedBySecrets: Staging blocked because this file may contain a secret.
GitStageBlockedByScan: Staging blocked because this file could not be inspected safely.
GitStageNoLongerEligible: The file changed and was not staged. Git status was refreshed.
GitCommitReadySummary: {0} staged ReqMint files passed the final security check
GitCommitSafetyNote: ReqMint reruns the exact Git-index preflight when you confirm. The commit is blocked if conflicts, secrets, unreadable content, or staged non-ReqMint files appear. This safe workflow does not run repository hooks, pull, or push.
GitCommitMessageInvalid: Use a single-line commit message between 3 and 72 characters.
GitCommitPreflightFailed: Commit safety check could not be completed
GitCommitBlockedByConflicts: Commit blocked until all merge conflicts are resolved
GitCommitBlockedByScope: Commit blocked because non-ReqMint files are staged
GitCommitBlockedBySecrets: Commit blocked because the Git index may contain a secret
GitCommitBlockedByScan: Commit blocked because the Git index could not be inspected safely
GitCommitNoStagedFiles: There are no staged ReqMint files to commit
GitRemoteReviewMessage: Fetch remote-tracking updates from {0}/{1} without changing your working tree or current branch.
GitRemoteSafetyRefs: Updates remote-tracking references only; it does not merge or rebase.
GitRemoteSafetyLocal: Does not change local files, the current branch, staged files, or commits.
GitRemoteSafetyNetwork: Contacts the configured remote without interactive credential prompts. Authentication requirements fail safely.
GitRemotePreflightFailed: Remote configuration could not be inspected
GitRemoteDetachedHead: Remote check requires an active local branch
GitRemoteUnsupported: This upstream configuration is not supported safely
GitRemoteNoUpstream: The current branch has no upstream remote
GitFetchFailed: Remote check failed; no local files were changed
GitFastForwardSafetyNote: Requires a clean repository and no unsaved request draft. Confirmation reruns every check, applies only a fast-forward, disables repository hooks, and never fetches or pushes.
GitFastForwardUnsavedDraft: Save or discard current request, environment, or collection edits before updating
GitFastForwardPreviewFailed: Incoming update preview could not be created
GitFastForwardPreviewTooLarge: Update blocked because the incoming scope is too large to review safely; use an external Git tool
GitFastForwardContainsOtherFiles: Update blocked because incoming commits change files outside ReqMint's scope; use an external Git tool
GitFastForwardDirty: Update blocked because the repository has local file changes
GitFastForwardConflicts: Update blocked until all merge conflicts are resolved
GitFastForwardDiverged: Update blocked because local and remote branches have diverged
GitFastForwardRemoteUnavailable: Update blocked because the upstream remote is unavailable
GitFastForwardNoUpdates: There are no incoming fast-forward updates
GitFastForwardReloadFailed: Git update completed, but the workspace must be reopened
GitFastForwardFailed: Workspace update could not be completed; check Git status
GitPushSafetyNote: Confirmation reruns every check and scans every outgoing commit snapshot. Push is limited to the current branch and configured upstream; force push, tags, other branches, and repository hooks are disabled. Unsaved editor changes are not included.
GitPushPreviewFailed: Outgoing push preview could not be created
GitPushPreviewTooLarge: Push blocked because the outgoing scope is too large to inspect safely; use an external Git tool
GitPushContainsOtherFiles: Push blocked because outgoing commits include files outside ReqMint's scope; use an external Git tool
GitPushDirty: Push blocked because the repository has local file changes
GitPushConflicts: Push blocked until all merge conflicts are resolved
GitPushBehind: Push blocked because the remote branch has newer commits; fetch and update first
GitPushDiverged: Push blocked because local and remote branches have diverged
GitPushBlockedBySecrets: Push blocked because an outgoing commit snapshot may contain a secret
GitPushBlockedByScan: Push blocked because every outgoing snapshot could not be inspected safely
GitPushRemoteUnavailable: Push blocked because the upstream remote is unavailable
GitPushNoCommits: There are no outgoing commits to push
GitPushFailed: Push could not be completed; no force push was attempted
